cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
cards.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The treasure map ends at a wall. Our real mission was to wake it. Knock with me; I taught you a firmer knock than that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nothing. Our torch is nearly out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the map brought us here to listen in darkness. I'm putting it out. Good, you've finally brought less equipment than we need.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can only hear you breathing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Breath control. That's what the map was testing. I'm holding mine; count for me, the way I taught you before your first dive.

reason: Make the former pupil relationship change the practical request, correction or interpretation. Preserve the useful original causal chain while repairing remote-audience knowledge and explicit bowl orientation.
